entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return something. I think it's the VeloBand Pulse? The new one.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Sure, it's Maria Valenti. The email is m.valenti@email.com.

Thank you, Maria. I see your recent order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 20th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Are you finding it's a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, um, neither really. I just... I haven't even opened it. I just need to send it back. The website was a bit confusing and now I'm just overwhelmed with it all.

I understand. Let me just review the return policy for that specific device. Okay, so for the VeloBand Pulse, because it's a bio-sensor that links to your account upon activation, we have a strict 10-day return window. Since the item was delivered 15 days ago, we are unfortunately outside of that period.
Ten days? Oh, I didn't see that. I thought it was longer. I... I just couldn't. Can't you just help me? There was a family emergency.

I'm sorry to hear that. Our policy is typically very firm to ensure device security and hygiene for all our customers, but you mentioned an emergency? We do have provisions for certain extenuating circumstances. Could you tell me a little more about what happened?

It's just been a mess. My husband is in the military, and his overseas deployment was suddenly moved up right after the package arrived. While we were handling that, my son had an accident and had to be rushed to the hospital. He needed emergency surgery and I've been there with him ever since. This is the first chance I've had to even breathe, let alone call about a return.

Oh my, Maria, I am so sorry to hear all of that. That sounds incredibly difficult. Please, don't worry about the 10-day window. That absolutely qualifies as an exception under our policy for military families and medical situations. I sincerely hope your son is recovering well, and we thank your husband for his service.
You can help? Oh, thank you. That is such a relief to hear.

Of course. Given the situation, I've been authorized to make a one-time exception and I am processing a full refund for you right now. I'm also sending a prepaid return label to your email. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you so much, Charlie. I really appreciate your understanding.
You are very welcome, Maria. Take care, and we wish your family all the best. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
